title: Finite etale representation of one integral root level
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $Y$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. For each $n\in\mathbf N$, let $M_n=R_Y\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mu_{\ell^n,Y}$ be exactly tateModuleLevel Y ell n of [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. There exists an object V of the small pro-etale site of Y such that its structure map to Y is finite and etale, and the universe-lifted representable set sheaf h_V is isomorphic to the underlying set sheaf of M_n. The forgetful functor takes M_n.X as an abelian sheaf and then forgets the abelian group structure. This is one level only: no transition maps, morphism of bases, normalization or inverse-limit comparison is part of the assertion.

source.place: Roots of unity paragraph (relative root scheme) and Integral twist paragraph (finite-level representation), specialized to the integral coefficient Z_ell.

proof.text: Let N=ell^n. The canonical quotient R_Y -> (Z/N)_Y makes the root sheaf an R_Y-module. Multiplication R_Y tensor_Z mu_N -> mu_N and z -> 1 tensor z are inverse. Check the identities on the primitive-root cover: there the statement is the free constant residue comparison, obtained from the coefficient quotient cokernel. The maps are canonical so the identities descend. Use the generator-normalized root comparison to pass between the two existing presentations. The underlying set sheaf of M_n is thus the root sheaf.

Over Spec Gamma(Y,O_Y), use the monic algebra Gamma(Y,O_Y)[t]/(t^N-1) and pull it back along Y.toSpecGamma. affineRoots_representability gives the natural bijection from maps into that scheme to roots on every Y-scheme. Monicity makes this a finite map, and N*t^(N-1) is a unit on the root scheme, so AdjoinRoot.etale_X_pow_sub_C makes it etale. Invertibility of ell in residue fields implies its global section is a unit, by the ringed-space unit criterion and the local residue criterion. Compose the section bijection with the preceding module/sheaf comparison and apply lifted Yoneda. For n=0 the representation is Y and the root group is zero; the construction also includes the empty scheme.

from.place: Canonical base-change comparison of the root-tower Tate line in f* K(d)[2d]; the finite-level representation used before taking the inverse limit.

lean.statement:
theorem tateLevelRepresentation (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (ell : Y.residueField y)] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ V : Y.ProEt, IsFinite V.hom ∧ Etale V.hom ∧
      Nonempty ((ProEt.topology Y).uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj V ≅
        (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (forget Ab.{u + 1})).obj
          (tateModuleLevel Y ell n).X)
